name: face-dummy-assets
description: Asset preparation scripts for the Face Dummy image CDN repository.

scripts.assets:import:avatar: node run-import.js --source-dir incoming/3d-avatar --type "3D Avatar" --prefix graphic-3d-avatar-square --preview-size 100x100 --paid-size 600x600 --paid Y
scripts.assets:import:realistic: node run-import.js --source-dir incoming/realistic --category "Realistic" --type "International Adult" --prefix realistic-international-adult --preview-size 100x100 --paid-size 600x600 --paid Y
